highlights: Undo on an inventory quantity now restores the original number. It was landing on a stale value and saving the result, so a packet at 2 became 1 after a tap-and-undo.
Seed packets you have used up no longer appear as sowable. They move to a new 'Sowed previously' list on Sow Now that keeps the full packet record, and they no longer show on the Today card either.
Feed cards no longer appear a day late for a feeding logged in the evening. Plan generation was reading the last feed date in UTC while the read path used Eastern time.
Schema-contract coverage: the audit's blind spot for JOINed relations narrowed from 186 undeclared references to 114.
New standing gate pins the sow-window fall-through as unreached, so a legitimate data fix can no longer move a close date months later in silence.
